scope: Add whole-operation allocation rollback and same-writer retry coverage for the explicit writeXRecordDwgCompatibility() route with XRECORD groups 1070 and 1071.

source.profile: One XRECORD with a signed 16-bit compatibility value 12345 at group 1070 and a 32-bit value 12346 at group 1071. No external or committed drawing fixture is used.

implementation.method: Extend the selected whole-file XRECORD control to inject operator-new failures across the direct compatibility writer operation in ASCII and Binary. Each failure must preserve the destination sentinel, caller handle/owner/values, then the same codec retries to bytes identical to the clean baseline; fresh typed readback checks both 1070 and 1071 values. Continue offsets until an uninjected clean write succeeds.

limitations: This proves transaction behavior for one generated compatibility-code profile only; it does not establish independent producer behavior or broader XRECORD code-domain support.
